basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and outdoor enthusiast from Colorado. I spend my weekends exploring the mountains and my evenings mastering strategy games online. I'm currently working as a software developer for a tech startup. Happily single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals through various subreddits. My typical online hours are late evenings, usually from 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained extensive knowledge in game mechanics and strategy through years of playing and participating in online forums. Self-taught programming skills, with a focus on game development and user interface design.
